The human brain is an interesting thing, it is designed (or evolved, if that word triggers you) to overcome adversity. The interesting part is that when there is no adversity, instead of switching off this ability and becoming sedentary, it makes up adversity to overcome. When people say their job is killing them, it's to keep this aspect of humanity going despite the fact the person has no immediate nor foreseeable survival problems.

Now back to your daughter. Depression, and identity problems are also a consequence of this function in the human brain, it's just the aspect the brain chose when creating the made up adversity. When dealing with it, the one thing you mustn't do is coddle her, and protect her obsessively, because her brain will realise that she isn't the one overcoming the adversity, and so it will make the problem worse. This leaves you with two options:

1) Put her on brain altering drugs. This will work by putting her in a permanent sedentary state, but she won't be your daughter anymore, not recognisably anyway.

2) You replace this made up adversity with something else. This will work by making her brain adapt to overcoming the new adversity, essentially making the old adversity stop, but it will only work if it is immediately clear that it won't be solved by her parents and has to be figured out by herself. HOWEVER, the cost to this is that your wife will hate you for it, and call you a heartless piece of shit, 'for abandoning your own daughter' and whatever else she will say to you.

Also if there is a medical reason for this then drugs may be necessary, but I don't know details so I can't make that call.
